events.label: Adult friends miserable; ski-trip escape after Jacob's crisis
events.description: Three middle-aged friends - Adam, Nick and Lou - are living failed versions of their lives, and a suicide scare plus a broken nose send them back to the ski lodge of their youth, dragging Adam's nephew Jacob along.

events.label: Hot tub + Russian energy drink → 1986
events.description: A night of drinking in the lodge's hot tub, spiked with a leaked Russian energy drink, spills them out into 1986 - the same weekend, thirty years early.

events.label: Arrive 1986 ski resort; bodies young (Jacob still 2010)
events.description: They wake as their young selves at the resort - except Jacob, who still exists in the present he might now never be born into.

events.label: Must avoid breaking past; Lou ignores and parties
events.description: The one instruction the weekend has: do nothing differently, touch nothing, change nothing - or the future warps. Lou ignores every word and parties like it's 1986.

events.label: Interventions: songs, relationships, injuries cascade
events.description: Nick performs songs that haven't been written yet, claims a relationship, and sets off cascades - every small intervention bends what comes next.

events.label: Present ripples — photos/phones show changed futures
events.description: The present starts editing itself: Adam's phone shows a different life, scars vanish, and the future their changes are writing keeps revising itself in their pockets.

events.label: Lou chooses to stay in 1986 and live differently
events.description: Lou chooses to stay in 1986 - the decade that broke him is now the one where he can fix everything first - and invests, invents and lives deliberately from there.

events.label: Actions fork improved 2010 for remaining friends
events.description: With Lou rewriting his own history, the remaining three return to a present their friend's choices have quietly improved.

events.label: Adam/Nick/Jacob return to rewritten present
events.description: Adam, Nick and Jacob land back in 2010 - or a 2010 reshaped around Lou's new life.

events.label: Lou is now rich/famous from 1986 path
events.description: Lou is now the wealthy, famous 'Loudermilk' - the man who cheated Chalet '86 into being his foundation, and won.

events.label: Jacob's life stabilized in new present
events.description: Jacob - who was fading - is restored in the new present, Lou's solid family life having secured his birth all along.

events.label: Hot tub remains a chaotic mutable device
events.description: The hot tub sits waiting with its Russian drink, still a chaotic door to anywhere its bathers bumble into.

events.label: Hot tub becomes time machine
events.description: The hot tub becomes a time machine - by accident, chemical and electrical.

events.label: Arrive 1986 ski weekend
events.description: The 1986 ski weekend where all their adult damage began.

events.label: Avoid/reproduce past mistakes
events.description: Trying to leave the past alone - and reproducing, then correcting, every mistake anyway.

events.label: Lou suicide threat alters
events.description: Lou's dark knot - the night he was planning to end himself - is found and untied in person.

events.label: Return to altered present
events.description: The return to a present reshaped by everything done in the tub.

events.label: Jacob existence ripple
events.description: Jacob's existence becomes the thread that matters most - the nephew whose birth depends on the weekend going right.

events.label: Actions rewrite personal futures
events.description: The rule this comedy runs on: whatever you do in 1986, your future rewrites to match.

events.label: Party night setpieces
events.description: The party night itself - the setpieces where past and present collide in hot water and neon.

ruleEffects.effect: Staying and altering 1986 overwrites friends' 2010 fortunes

outcome.summary: Comedy overwrite: Lou's 1986 life remakes 2010 into success; tub remains dangerous.
